summary.name: Blue Fang
summary.desc: The easily obtainable blue fossil of a great beast's fang.

raw.desc: The easily obtainable blue fossil of a great beast's fang.
raw.name: Blue Fang

dictionary.lore: The Blue Fang can be collected in the mountains around Elgaia and all over Mistral. The biggest fangs can be as large as a human head. They are dense and heavy, making them perfect for weapons such as axes. They've been one of the most heavily used materials since ancient times due to how easy they are to obtain and process.
